nodes.text: and killed the priests of the
idols, and struck dead many hundreds
of the heathen. Then the emperor grew
angry and would have it that she did it
by sorcery, and had her searched [to see]
whether she had any sorcery on her,
and had her hair cut off, [in case]
the power lay in her locks. Then
she said: I do not do it by sorcery;
Christ, God's Son, does this. Then
he ordered his servants to beat the virgin
